newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - BAER LOWERS CS TO "SELL".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BAER LOWERS CS TO "SELL".

text.p: Bank Julius Baer lowered Credit Suisse Group from hold to a sell recommendation based on a planned share-swap takeover of major Swiss insurer Winterthur.
"We recommend to switch CSG shares into SBC, UBS or Zurich stock," Baer senior analyst Hans Kaufmann wrote in a study.
"Bearing in mind additional risks the merger involves, the earnings dilution in 1997 and 1998 and cost problems, we think the CSG shares are fully valued," he wrote.
Baer told Reuters he was maintaining Swiss Banc Corp (SBC) as a buy and Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) as a hold.
Kaufmann wrote that it could be difficult for CS Group to get the 98 percent of Winterthur shares it needs in order to carry out a fast-track acquisition.
If fewer shares are offered, a more costly procedure would be needed involving creating a holding structure on top of Winterthur.
Kaufmann said this could add 400 million Swiss francs to the cost of the deal.
"The question as to what BK Vision will do with the CSG shares they receive for their 25 percent Winterthur share block remains open," Kaufmann added.
